_doc: Reference of the deployment contract and of tests/test_shipped_weights.py: the non-tensor payload and the tensor manifest of the shipped pair (model.pt = A, model_b.pt = B), read with torch.load(mmap=True).
Paths: an absolute path containing oct_tta_data, oct_tta_runs or oct_tta_ckpts has the prefix before that directory replaced by ${OCTTTA_SCRATCH}.

scrubbed_paths: string values stored as 'sha256:<hex of the UTF-8 original>' because the release tree may not carry their text (non-ASCII, research codes, machine paths); every one is a provenance or no_reader path of retrained_register, so the contract never compares its value.
Non-finite floats are stored as the strings 'inf', '-inf', 'nan'.

retrained_register: every path a retrained export may differ in. provenance = identifies how and where the artefact was made; no_reader = nothing that reads the shipped config (server assembler + trainer, inference, fusion selection, probes) reads the value. Its config paths equal the recipe register entries of configs/reproduction/model_a/coteach.yaml (A) and configs/reproduction/model_b/cnn.yaml (B) plus the normalisation of tests/test_recipes.py (DROPPED, RENAMED); that test asserts it.

A.why: lineage stamp; absent in checkpoints of the release trainer, false in the shipped pair (the contract's payload rule refuses true)
lineage stamp text; read by nothing that decides behaviour
absolute path of the warm start; differs per machine and per run
hash of the training config of the run that wrote the checkpoint
epoch counter of the source checkpoint
selection score of the source checkpoint (-inf in a run that never evaluates)
name of the selection metric of the source run
last topology read-out of the source run; the server fine-tune logs it
path string of the exported checkpoint
training-state keys the source checkpoint happened to carry
the plan of the source checkpoint before the export baked its decisions (plan_after is compared)
a constant note of the exporter
